description: FEAT-CTX clipboard texts: frmMain CopyChartoClip (+InvenCopytoClipboard), CopyMonsterToClipboard, CopyShopToClipboard and modMain CopyLVLinetoClipboard over ListView and control stand-ins.
notes: Each case reads what the code left on the clipboard (%clip); a VB error that stopped a procedure shows in events and leaves it empty. SetClipboardText ignores a blank text, as the real procedure does.

A ListView is {$cliplv: {name, columns: [[Text, Width]], rows: [{Text, Sub, Sel}]}}; a column of width 0 is hidden. CopyLVLinetoClipboard clicks each row first (frmMain.lvX_ItemClick); here that does nothing, so every row shares the one detail text and reference list the case gives. The Rust function takes them per row.

The character cases fill the controls CopyChartoClip reads (Tag strings of the Char tab, lblInvenCharStat captions, the equipment combos); lblInvenCharStat(32, 43, 44, 45) are invisible, as in the designer. data holds the stock ExpTable of the classes and races the cases use, for CalcExpNeededByRaceClass.
